# #1723: Patch: the Duos AI passes a card only when the trade is worth it
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

In a co-op game the computer-controlled teammate will hand a card to its partner whenever it *can* — it never asks whether it *should*. A card it could use well itself, or one that costs mana to pass and buys the partner little, gets shipped anyway. After the change, the AI weighs the card's value in its own hand against what the partner would gain from it plus the pass cost, and keeps the card when the trade is a bad one.

## Why

When the duel-level decision is `EndTurn`, `pass_or_end` (`crates/ai/src/duos.rs:142-154`) sends the first card `duos_passes` returns — whenever any qualifying card exists, a pass fires. `rank_now`/`pass_score` (:334-424) only *order* the candidates; nothing weighs the partner's scored follow-up against the seat's own keep value (`hand_card_value`) and the pass's mana cost (spec §13.5, §13.7). §13.7 says "it passes the best cards first" — a worth-it gate is compatible with that letter (best-first ordering preserved); if a stricter reading of "a seat passes a hand card it cannot play this turn and its teammate can" is intended, the spec needs a one-line amendment, which the change can carry as a ruling note.

## Proposal

Gate the pass: pass the top-ranked candidate only when `pass_score` (the teammate's bounded follow-up value) exceeds the seat's keep value plus a named margin covering `pass_cost`; otherwise end the turn. The margin is a constant in `crates/ai/src/config.rs`.

## Where it lands

`crates/ai/src/duos.rs`, `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, tests in `crates/ai/tests/ai/duos.rs`; spec §13.5/§13.7 (plus a ruling note if the pass-when-able reading is amended).

## Acceptance criteria

- A scenario where the card's keep value exceeds the mate's scored follow-up ends the turn without passing.
- A clearly-profitable pass (cheap cost, big mate follow-up) still fires.
- The `duos` fuzz and `cargo jackioh gate --duos` smoke stay green.

## Size and risks

Small-medium (2 files plus tests). The one open question is the spec reading — decide gate-vs-always-pass with the ruling-note route documented in `docs/issues-and-patches.md` before building.
